issues.detail: The Hebrew place name עֶצְיוֹן גֶּבֶר (Ezion-geber) is rendered as '以順基伯城' — the first element is transliterated as '以順' instead of the standard '以旬' (Ezion), and the second element 'גֶּבֶר' is rendered as '基伯' rather than '迦別' (Geber). This is a name distortion, not a mere stylistic choice, as it changes the recognizable proper name.
